description: Ruida RD fixtures for BurnBurn tests. Bytes are unmodified copies of the research corpus; sha256/bytes are checked by burnburn-test-support (test ruida_fixture_hashes_match_manifest) and cross-checked against the research manifest.
oracle_note: oracle/*.json is the output of the independent Python research decoder (research/lightburn/tools/rd_inspect.py). It is a development oracle for comparing the Rust decoder, NOT a runtime dependency; Python is never required to build or run BurnBurn. The splitter is a research tool and does not define the complete grammar; unknown records stay visible as UNKNOWN.
golden_policy: Never update these bytes or hashes automatically. A changed expectation needs a reviewed explanation (AGENTS.md).

fixtures.name: rectangle-default
fixtures.conditions: LightBurn Core 2.1.04 native RD export of rectangle.svg (30 x 15 mm, imported via native import; the saved project has MirrorX/MirrorY and its own XForm, so SVG coordinates are not RD coordinates). Layer C00, speed 100 mm/s, min/max power 20%, air on, 1 pass, mode Line. Effective corners about (771.687; 448.024)-(801.687; 463.024) mm in a 1500 x 900 mm research profile.

fixtures.name: rectangle-fill
fixtures.conditions: As rectangle-default, but mode Fill: interval 0.1 mm, angle 0 deg, bidirectional, no cross-hatch/flood/ramp. Line/Fill difference set in the app; bytes not modified afterwards.

fixtures.name: gray-ramp-grayscale
fixtures.conditions: LightBurn Core 2.1.04 native RD export of gray-ramp.png (own 16x4 pixel tone ramp, imported at about 5.643739 x 1.410935 mm), mode Grayscale, speed 100 mm/s, min 1%, max 60%, interval 0.1 mm, bidirectional. An earlier attempt with min=max=20% was aborted by the app; no RD exists for it.
